run_ocr_layout: run OCR layout detection on a PDF page image using the Chandra vision language model
load_model_inference: load a Chandra inference model using huggingface transformers or vLLM server
get_page_image_from_pdf: extract a single page image from a PDF file by page number
count_pdf_pages: count the total number of pages in a PDF file
embed_images_in_markdown: replace image filenames in markdown text with base64 data URLs
